notes: Live connectivity is expected only on the district network.
Table grounding is seeded from operator-provided project context and must be verified against the live SIS schema inventory before being treated as database truth.
External eSchoolPlus mapping docs are comparison hints only; they are not proof that a table or column exists in this district database.

entities.name: student_registration

support_tables.description: Supportive campus/building reference table. Other SIS tables link to it by building/location number for campus name, address, building type, and campus metadata.
support_tables.active_status_note: Campus active/inactive status is not proven to live in dbo.REG_BUILDING. Treat active campus filtering as a separate status lookup/rule that must be verified against live schema and district practice.

activity_inference.student_status_rule: Use current/active student registration records, such as REG.CURRENT_STATUS = 'A', once the district's live status rule is confirmed.
activity_inference.meaning: A building with current student records tied to its building/location number is operational evidence that the campus is active or in use. This is inferred activity evidence, not the official campus active flag.

active_status_candidates_to_verify.caution: This appears to mark building-type code activity, not necessarily an individual campus/building as active.

entities.description: Latest captured student registration snapshot and student campus assignment by building/location number.

entities.name: program_memberships
entities.description: Program-level student associations that can be summarized or filtered by campus and year. District population indicators such as foster, dyslexia, military, 504, GT, EB, at-risk, and special education are grounded by PROGRAM_ID/FIELD_NUMBER pairs in population_definitions.json.

entities.name: district_registration_history
entities.description: District enrollment history timeline tracking student enrollment, campus movement, and in-year grade movement within the school district over time.
notes: Treat as the district enrollment timeline rather than the latest captured student snapshot.
Use this table for current-year grade change history, including when and where the change happened.
REG may show only the latest captured student state, while REG_ENTRY_WITH preserves the movement history that led to it.
Exact live column inventory should be confirmed through schema_inventory before adding direct query templates.
